faculty.name: Mark Blumberg
faculty.summary: Studies the neural bases and functions of sleep, sensorimotor development, and developmental neurophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠的神经基础和功能、传感器运动的发展以及发育神经生理学。

faculty.name: Bengi Baran
faculty.summary: Studies sleep-related developmental biomarkers of psychopathology and sleep-dependent memory consolidation using EEG/ERP and fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与心理障碍发展相关的睡眠生物标志物以及睡眠依赖的记忆巩固，使用EEG/ERP和fMRI方法。

faculty.name: Bruce Bartholow
faculty.summary: Studies how alcohol affects cognitive control and social categorization, using EEG/ERP and cognitive tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究酒精如何影响认知控制和社会分类，使用EEG/ERP和认知任务。

faculty.name: Scott Bolkan
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and context-dependent decision-making, linking cognitive dysfunction to psychiatric diseases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和情境依赖性决策，将认知功能障碍与精神疾病联系起来。

faculty.name: Jeffrey Cockburn
faculty.summary: Studies how value and risk are represented in the brain during decision making, using computational models and brain imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程中大脑如何表示价值和风险，使用计算模型和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Susan Wagner Cook
faculty.summary: Studies how hand gestures aid in mathematical learning and memory consolidation, using various experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究手势如何促进数学学习和记忆巩固，使用多种实验方法。

faculty.name: Ece Demir-Lira
faculty.summary: Studies how socioeconomic status affects brain development and academic performance, using brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位如何影响大脑发展和学业表现，使用脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Natalie Denburg
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience of aging, real-world decision-making, and individual differences in older adults, using neuroimaging and psychophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究老化过程中的认知神经科学、现实世界中的决策以及个体差异，使用神经成像和生理心理学方法。

faculty.name: John Freeman
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain learns and categorizes information, using rats and pigeons in experiments on learning and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何学习和分类信息，使用老鼠和鸽子进行学习和记忆实验。

faculty.name: Prahlad Gupta
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between language processing, working memory, and memory mechanisms, using computational and neural evidence.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言处理、工作记忆和记忆机制之间的关系，使用计算和神经证据的方法。

faculty.name: Eliot Hazeltine
faculty.summary: Studies how actions and executive functions interact, using EEG/ERP and brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动作和执行功能的相互作用，使用ERP和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Andrew Hollingworth
faculty.summary: Studies attention, eye movements, and visual memory using scene perception and spatial cognition experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意力、眼动和视觉记忆，使用场景感知和空间认知实验。

faculty.name: Kai Hwang
faculty.summary: Studies the neural, cognitive, and developmental dynamics of cognitive control, using multimodal neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制的神经、认知和发展动态，使用多模态神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Jiefeng Jiang
faculty.summary: Studies neurocomputational mechanisms of complex behavior, learning and memory, and aging of executive function using computational modeling and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂行为的神经计算机制、学习与记忆以及执行功能的老化，使用计算建模和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Dorit Kliemann
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of social cognition, particularly in individuals with autism, using fMRI and brain lesion studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知的神经基础，特别是在自闭症个体中的表现，使用功能性磁共振成像和脑损伤研究。

faculty.name: Grazyna Kochanska
faculty.summary: Studies the development of conscience, parent-child interaction, and child temperament in social development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究良知的发展、亲子互动以及儿童气质在社会发展中作用的认知神经科学。

faculty.name: Ethan Kutlu
faculty.summary: Studies how bilinguals process speech and words, using eye-tracking and EEG/ERP to understand language diversity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究双语者如何处理语音和单词，使用眼动追踪和ERP来理解语言多样性。

faculty.name: Ryan LaLumiere
faculty.summary: Studies how learning and memory work in rodents, focusing on addiction and neural plasticity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的学习和记忆机制，特别是成瘾和神经可塑性。

faculty.name: Susan Lutgendorf
faculty.summary: Studies the biobehavioral pathways linking stress, mindfulness, and cancer outcomes, using various clinical and molecular methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力、正念与癌症结果之间的生物行为学途径，采用多种临床和分子方法。

faculty.name: Bob McMurray
faculty.summary: Studies how children and adults recognize and learn words, using eye-tracking and cognitive neuroscience techniques like ERP, with a focus on language impairment and cochlear implants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何识别和学习单词，使用眼动追踪和事件相关电位等认知神经科学技术，重点关注语言障碍和人工耳蜗植入。

faculty.name: Cathleen Moore
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and attention, focusing on object perception and perceptual organization, using visual search and working memory experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，专注于物体知觉和知觉组织，使用视觉搜索和工作记忆实验。

faculty.name: Isabel Muzzio
faculty.summary: Studies how fear, spatial reorientation, and sleep affect memory in mice using single-unit recording and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究恐惧、空间定向和睡眠对小鼠记忆的影响，使用单细胞记录和光遗传学技术。

faculty.name: Molly Nikolas
faculty.summary: Studies the gene-environment interplay in the development of ADHD and externalizing behaviors, focusing on neurocognitive functioning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因-环境交互作用在注意力缺陷多动障碍和外部化行为发展中的作用，重点关注神经认知功能。

faculty.name: Isaac Petersen
faculty.summary: Studies developmental psychopathology, focusing on externalizing behavior problems and self-regulation in children, using EEG/ERP and cognitive neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童外部行为问题和自我调节的发展心理障碍，使用EEG/ERP和认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Jodie Plumert
faculty.summary: Studies how children and typically- and atypically-developing populations perceive and judge affordances, particularly in road-crossing scenarios, using virtual reality and parent-child interaction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童及其异常发展群体在道路穿越场景中如何感知和判断可利用性，使用虚拟现实和亲子互动实验。

faculty.name: Jason Radley
faculty.summary: Studies the neural control of adaptive responses to stress and chronic stress-induced structural plasticity in cortical systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究应激的神经控制及其引起的慢性应激对皮层系统的结构可塑性影响。

faculty.name: David Schwebel
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive control and development of executive functions in children using behavioral tasks and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知控制和执行功能的发展，使用行为任务和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: James Traer
faculty.summary: Studies perception of natural scenes, especially hearing and audiovisual integration, using models and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自然场景的感知，特别是听觉和视听整合，使用模型和机器学习方法。

faculty.name: Daniel Tranel
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of higher cognitive functions and personality using lesion methods and functional neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高级认知功能和人格的神经基础，使用病损方法和功能性神经影像学。

faculty.name: Teresa Treat
faculty.summary: Studies perception, judgment and decision making, and social cognition, focusing on sexual aggression and disordered eating.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉、判断与决策以及社会认知，重点关注性侵犯和饮食障碍。

faculty.name: Shaun Vecera
faculty.summary: Studies visual attention and perception, focusing on how attention is directed and controlled during visual search tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉注意和感知，重点在于注意力在视觉搜索任务中的定向和控制。

faculty.name: Michelle Voss
faculty.summary: Studies the aging brain and cognition using cognitive neuroscience methods, focusing on the effects of health behaviors on brain structure and function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究衰老的大脑和认知，采用认知神经科学方法，关注健康行为对大脑结构和功能的影响。

faculty.name: Edward Wasserman
faculty.summary: Studies how animals learn and remember concepts, focusing on causation and visual perception, using comparative analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物的概念学习和记忆，特别是因果关系和视觉感知，采用比较分析方法。

faculty.name: Jan Wessel
faculty.summary: Studies how surprising events impact thoughts and actions, and how humans cancel and correct movements.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究意外事件如何影响思维和行为，以及人类如何取消和纠正动作。

faculty.name: Paul Windschitl
faculty.summary: Studies how people make decisions under uncertainty, particularly focusing on optimistic and pessimistic biases in health and medical contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不确定性情境下的决策过程，特别是健康和医疗决策中的乐观和悲观偏差。

faculty.name: Debbie Yee
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive control and affective neuroscience using computational modeling and brain imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制和情感神经科学，使用计算建模和脑成像方法。

faculty.name: Ted Abel
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of memory storage and neurodevelopmental disorders using mouse models and transgenic approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆存储和神经发育障碍的分子机制，使用小鼠模型和转基因方法。

faculty.name: Limbic System
faculty.summary: Studies how genes and environment interact to affect memory and behavior, using mouse models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因和环境如何相互作用影响记忆和行为，使用小鼠模型。

faculty.name: MD Georgina Aldridge
faculty.summary: Studies neurodegenerative disorders, particularly Dementia with Lewy Bodies, using systems and behavioral neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病，特别是路易体痴呆，采用系统和行为神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Zahra Aminzare
faculty.summary: Studies the collective behavior of coupled cell networks, including neural and bacterial systems, using dynamical systems and PDEs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究耦合细胞网络的集体行为，包括神经和细菌系统，使用动力系统和偏微分方程方法。

faculty.name: MD Steven Anderson
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and behavioral impairments resulting from brain damage, using neuropsychological tests and MRI in patients.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑损伤导致的认知和行为障碍，使用神经心理学测试和MRI对患者进行研究。

faculty.name: Deniz Atasoy
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits regulating feeding behavior and metabolism, using optogenetics, electrophysiology, and behavioral analysis in rodent models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究调节进食行为和新陈代谢的神经回路，使用光遗传学、电生理学和行为分析方法，以啮齿动物模型为对象。

faculty.name: Biomedical Engineering
faculty.summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using interdisciplinary approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为的认知神经科学系统。

faculty.name: Basal Ganglia
faculty.summary: Studies the function of basal ganglia in movement and cognition using computational models and neural recordings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基底节在运动和认知中的功能，使用计算模型和神经记录方法。

faculty.name: Mark S. Blumberg
faculty.summary: Studies how sensorimotor development is influenced by sleep twitches, using electrophysiology and transgenic models in animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠抽搐如何影响运动感觉发展，使用电生理学和转基因模型在动物中进行探究。

faculty.name: Sensorimotor Cortex
faculty.summary: Studies the sensorimotor cortex and its role in behavior and movement, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉运动皮层及其在行为和运动中的作用，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Internal Medicine
faculty.summary: Studies ion channels and their role in disease, using electrophysiology and genetic approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究离子通道及其在疾病中的作用，使用电生理学和遗传学方法。

faculty.name: MD Aubrey Chan
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of anxiety disorders in mice and humans using electrophysiology and transgenic models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍的神经机制，使用电生理学和转基因模型在小鼠和人类中进行.

faculty.name: Inyong Choi
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of speech-in-noise processing in normal and impaired hearing listeners, using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究正常和听力受损个体在噪声背景中言语理解的神经机制，使用神经影像学技术。

faculty.name: Computational Psychiatry
faculty.summary: Studies computational models of cognitive processes, using computational tools to understand brain function and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算工具研究认知过程和脑功能的心理认知神经科学。

faculty.name: Huxing Cui
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and intraneuronal signaling mechanisms regulating appetite, sleep, and cardiorespiratory function in mice, using advanced neuroscience techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小鼠调节食欲、睡眠和心血管功能的神经环路和细胞内信号机制，采用先进的神经科学技术。

faculty.name: MD Brian Dlouhy
faculty.summary: Studies the neural networks in the brain that influence breathing during seizures, using animal models and children with epilepsy to understand SUDEP.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中影响癫痫发作期间呼吸的神经网络，使用动物模型和患有癫痫的儿童来理解SUDEP。

faculty.name: Daniel Eberl
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of hearing in Drosophila, using genetics, electrophysiology, and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇听觉系统的分子和细胞机制，使用遗传学、电生理学和行为方法。

faculty.name: Sarah Ferri
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying social behaviors and sex differences in neurodevelopmental disorders using behavioral, molecular, and imaging techniques with rodent models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会行为的神经机制以及性别的差异在神经发育障碍中的作用，使用行为、分子和成像技术以及啮齿动物模型。

faculty.name: Carrie Figdor
faculty.summary: Explores theoretical issues in integrating neuroscience and psychology, the relation between human and nonhuman cognition, and ethical implications of neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 探讨神经科学与心理学的整合理论问题，人类与非人类认知的关系以及神经科学的伦理影响。

faculty.name: Kyle Flippo
faculty.summary: Studies how communication between endocrine tissues and the central nervous system influences motivated behavior and decision-making, using behavioral models and in vivo neural recording.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究内分泌组织与中枢神经系统之间的通讯如何影响动机行为和决策制定，使用行为模型和在体神经记录方法。

faculty.name: MD Jeremy Greenlee
faculty.summary: Studies the cortical mechanisms of human language and vocalization using electrophysiological recording in awake patients.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类语言和发声的大脑机制，使用清醒患者体内的电生理记录方法。

faculty.name: MSc Banu Gumusoglu
faculty.summary: Studies how complications of pregnancy affect offspring brain development, focusing on neuroimmune and endocrine factors in the placenta-brain axis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究妊娠并发症如何影响胎儿大脑发育，重点关注胎盘-大脑轴上的神经免疫和内分泌因素。

faculty.name: MD Lyndsay Harshman
faculty.summary: Studies brain growth and development in pediatric chronic kidney disease using MRI and neurocognitive testing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究慢性肾病儿童的大脑生长和发展，使用MRI和神经认知测试。

faculty.name: Karin Hoth
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and psychological changes in adults with chronic cardiopulmonary diseases, focusing on physiological mechanisms and anxiety/depression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究慢性心血管和肺部疾病成人的认知和心理变化，重点关注生理机制和焦虑/抑郁。

faculty.name: Taylor Jay
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons and glia work together to form and maintain synaptic connections, using genetic, biochemical, imaging, and behavioral approaches in fruit flies and mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元和胶质细胞如何合作形成和维持突触连接，使用遗传学、生物化学、成像和行为学方法在果蝇和小鼠中进行研究。

faculty.name: Jing Jiang
faculty.summary: Studies the neural and psychological processes of language and emotion in social interaction, using neuroimaging and neuromodulation techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言和情绪的社会互动神经和心理过程，使用神经成像和神经调节技术。

faculty.name: Alan R. Kay
faculty.summary: Studies the role of vesicular zinc in synaptic transmission and develops techniques for imaging neuronal activity in the cerebral cortex.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究囊泡中锌的作用以及开发成像神经元活动的技术，特别是在大脑皮层。

faculty.name: Toshihiro Kitamoto
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic basis of complex behaviors like learning, memory, sleep, and mood using Drosophila genetics and molecular, cellular, and systems approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂行为（如学习、记忆、睡眠和情绪）的遗传基础，使用果蝇遗传学和分子、细胞和系统方法。

faculty.name: Ryan T. LaLumiere
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuitry of memory consolidation and cocaine-seeking behavior in rats using optogenetics and in vivo electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆巩固和可卡因觅药行为的神经环路，使用光遗传学和在体电生理学方法在大鼠中进行.

faculty.name: Hans-Joachim Lehmler
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of environmental pollutants on the developing brain, using exposomics and metabolomics approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境污染物对发育中大脑的影响，使用暴露组学和代谢组学方法。

faculty.name: Jia Luo
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of alcohol-induced damage to the brain and its effects on neurodegeneration and behavior, using transgenic models and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究酒精对大脑的细胞和分子机制损伤及其对神经退行性疾病和行为的影响，使用转基因模型和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Vince Magnotta
faculty.summary: Develops novel imaging approaches and analysis strategies to understand psychiatric and neurological disorders, focusing on diffusion tensor and chemical shift imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发新的成像方法和分析策略，以更好地理解精神和神经疾病，重点关注扩散张量成像和化学移相成像。

faculty.name: Drosophila CNS
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive neuroscience of learning and memory in fruit flies using behavioral assays and genetic tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇的认知神经科学，使用行为测试和遗传工具研究学习和记忆。

faculty.name: David Moser
faculty.summary: Studies vascular disease and cognitive decline in the elderly, assessing decisional capacity in vulnerable populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究血管疾病和老年人的认知衰退，评估脆弱人群的决策能力。

faculty.name: MD Nandakumar Narayanan
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive dysfunction in Parkinson’s disease using systems neuroscience, in vivo electrophysiology, and neuromodulation techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究帕金森病的认知功能障碍，使用系统神经科学、在体电生理学和神经调节技术。

faculty.name: MD Kirill Nourski
faculty.summary: Studies the functional organization of human auditory cortex through electrophysiological recordings, focusing on how the brain processes sound and the effects of attention and degraded listening.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类听皮层的功能组织，通过电生理记录探讨大脑如何处理声音以及注意力和降噪条件的影响。

faculty.name: Krystal L. Parker
faculty.summary: Studies the cerebellar contribution to cognition using neurophysiology, pharmacology, and optogenetics in animals, and EEG in humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小脑对认知的贡献，使用神经生理学、药理学和光遗传学技术在动物中，以及使用EEG在人类中。

faculty.name: Christopher Petkov
faculty.summary: Studies the neuronal mechanisms and circuits of learning, memory, and sensory integration in primates and humans, using computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵长类和人类学习、记忆和感官整合的神经机制和电路，使用计算模型。

faculty.name: Jason J. Radley
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuitry underlying adaptive neuroendocrine responses to stress, using behavioral and cellular approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究应激下的神经内分泌反应的神经环路，采用行为和细胞方法。

faculty.name: Rasna Sabharwal
faculty.summary: Studies brain mechanisms of Alzheimer’s disease, psychiatric disorders, and heart failure using optogenetics, pharmacology, and transgenic models in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病、精神障碍和心力衰竭的大脑机制，使用光遗传学、药理学和转基因小鼠模型。

faculty.name: Justin S. Sipla
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution of semicircular canals in birds, dinosaurs, pterosaurs, and bats, using imaging techniques to assess functional morphology and correlates with locomotor maneuverability.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鸟类、非鸟类恐龙、翼龙和蝙蝠的半规管进化，使用成像技术评估功能形态并与其运动灵活性相关联。

faculty.name: Levi Sowers
faculty.summary: Studies the neurocircuitry underlying migraine and post-traumatic headache, using MRI and optogenetic approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究偏头痛和创伤后头痛的神经环路，使用MRI和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: MD Janice Staber
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of cerebral microbleeds and neuroinflammation on brain structure and behavior in hemophilia A using mouse models and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑微出血和神经炎症对血友病A患者脑结构和行为的影响，使用小鼠模型和神经影像学技术。

faculty.name: MD Hanna Stevens
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of prenatal stress and environmental factors on early brain development and childhood behavior, using mouse models and family cohorts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究孕期应激和环境因素对早期大脑发育及儿童行为的影响，使用小鼠模型和家庭队列进行研究。

faculty.name: Adele Stewart
faculty.summary: Studies how sex-biased neuronal architecture affects the behavioral consequences of mental illness risk factors, focusing on dopamine signaling in the brain.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性别的神经架构如何影响精神疾病风险因素的行为后果，重点研究大脑中的多巴胺信号传导。

faculty.name: MBBS Lane Strathearn
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of mother-infant attachment and neurodevelopmental disabilities like autism, using functional MRI and smartphone apps.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究母婴依恋的神经生物学和神经发育障碍如自闭症，使用功能性磁共振成像和智能手机应用程序。

faculty.name: Peter Thorne
faculty.summary: Studies the toxicity of inhaled pollutants and engineered nanomaterials on lung, immune, neurological, and endocrine systems, translating findings to human health risk assessment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究吸入污染物和工程纳米材料对肺、免疫、神经和内分泌系统的影响，并将研究结果转化为人类健康风险评估。

faculty.name: Seth Tomchik
faculty.summary: Studies how genetic disorders affect neurodevelopmental processes, learning, and metabolism, using molecular, cellular, and circuit-level techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究遗传性疾病如何影响神经发育过程、学习和新陈代谢，使用分子、细胞和神经回路水平的技术。

faculty.name: Daniel T. Tranel
faculty.summary: Studies brain-behavior relationships in humans using lesion and neuroimaging methods, focusing on memory, emotion, and decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑与行为的关系，使用损伤和神经成像方法，重点关注记忆、情绪和决策。

faculty.name: MD Nicholas Trapp
faculty.summary: Studies the physiologic effects of brain stimulation therapies, particularly rTMS, and their applications in clinical trials for psychiatric disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑刺激疗法（特别是rTMS）的生理效应及其在精神疾病临床试验中的应用。

faculty.name: MD Ergun Uc
faculty.summary: Studies how Parkinson's disease affects driving safety, using cognitive and visual functions to predict risky driving behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究帕金森病如何影响驾驶安全，通过认知和视觉功能预测危险的驾驶行为。

faculty.name: Shaun P. Vecera
faculty.summary: Studies visual attention and perception, using behavioral and neuropsychological methods to understand normal and impaired processing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉注意力和感知，使用行为和神经心理学方法来理解正常和受损的处理过程。

faculty.name: Yangyang Wang
faculty.summary: Studies how complex activity patterns in neuronal systems are produced and how they drive animal behaviors, using computational modeling and differential equations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元系统中复杂活动模式的产生及其如何驱动动物行为，使用计算建模和微分方程。

faculty.name: MD John Wemmie
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of Acid Sensing Ion Channels (ASICs) on behavior in mice, focusing on fear conditioning and anxiety disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究酸敏离子通道（ASICs）对小鼠行为的影响，特别是在恐惧条件反射和焦虑障碍方面。

faculty.name: Jan R. Wessel
faculty.summary: Studies how humans maintain goal-directed behaviors, focusing on brain networks that monitor the environment, evaluate actions, and adapt behavior, using EEG, fMRI, and TMS.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何维持目标导向行为，关注监控环境、评估行为和适应行为的脑网络，使用EEG、fMRI和TMS等方法。

faculty.name: MD Aislinn Williams
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of genetic risk factors contributing to psychiatric disorders, using stem cells and transgenic mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究遗传风险因素对精神疾病分子和细胞机制的影响，使用诱导多能干细胞和转基因小鼠。

faculty.name: Virginia Willour
faculty.summary: Studies genetic and epigenetic risk factors for suicidal behavior, using GWAS and epigenetics in post-mortem brain studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自杀行为的遗传和表观遗传风险因素，使用全基因组关联研究和死后大脑研究。

faculty.name: Androgen-related Disease Signaling Pathways
faculty.summary: Studies signaling pathways related to androgen in diseases, using molecular and cellular methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与雄激素相关的疾病信号通路，采用分子和细胞方法。

faculty.name: Protein Biomarkers
faculty.summary: Studies protein biomarkers related to neurological disorders, using laboratory research methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与神经疾病相关的蛋白质生物标志物，采用实验室研究方法。

faculty.name: Androgen Signaling Networks
faculty.summary: Studies androgen signaling networks and their impact on behavior and cognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究雄性激素信号网络及其对行为和认知的影响。

faculty.name: Chun-Fang Wu
faculty.summary: Studies genetic mechanisms of nervous system function and behavior in Drosophila, focusing on neuronal plasticity, learning behavior, and social interactions affecting lifespan and stress resistance.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇神经系统的功能和行为的遗传机制，重点关注神经元可塑性、学习行为以及社会互动对寿命和应激抵抗的影响。

faculty.name: Interventional Neuroradiology
faculty.summary: Studies cerebrovascular diseases and interventions using neurosurgical techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑血管疾病和干预措施，使用神经外科技术。
